svg.title: Multi-head attention: heads are column blocks of Q, K and V, addressed by stride
svg.text: output = Concat(H₀, …, H₃): head i writes columns i·dk … (i+1)·dk − 1
Element (r, c) of head i is at r·d_model + i·dk + c: a head is only a base
offset and a row stride, so splitting and concatenating heads move no data.
